name: Open Heart
source:
A first year intern at Edenbrook Hospital must adapt to the stress of their new job while dealing with a jealous colleague, a shady businessman intent on destroying their career, and discovering what it means to be a good doctor.

[From [url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/Category:Open_Heart]Choices Wikia[/url]]
translation:
伊登布鲁克医院的第一年实习生必须适应新工作的压力，同时应对嫉妒的同事、意图毁掉他们职业生涯的阴暗商人，并发现成为一名好医生意味着什么。

[来自[url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/Category:Open_Heart]Choices Wikia[/url]]
